Meet Our Hospitality Leadership Team | Hotel Equities

# Meet The Team

Get to know the dedicated professionals who drive our culture, performance, and commitment to delivering excellence in hospitality. Led by Chief Executive Officer Ben Rafter, a technology entrepreneur with extensive experience scaling hotel platforms, the company manages a diverse portfolio with three specialized verticals: Full Service, Focused Service, and Springboard Hospitality, the Lifestyle Division.

# Executive Team

Benjamin Rafter

Chief Executive Officer 

Benjamin Rafter

Chief Executive Officer

Ben Rafter is the Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities, a leading hospitality management and development firm with a portfolio of hotels, resorts, and outdoor hospitality destinations spanning the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America. A recognized innovator at the intersection of hospitality and technology, Rafter assumed leadership of the combined Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality organization in May 2025, bringing with him a track record of building tech-forward operating platforms, including Hospitality Intelligence (H.I.) and HE Labs, that drive measurable performance for owners. Earlier in his career, he led Aqua Hospitality to become the largest hotel operator in Hawaii and co-founded Innerlinx (LiveBid), which was acquired by Amazon.com. He serves on the Board of Directors of the American Hotel & Lodging Association (AHLA).

Albert Smith

Chief Operating Officer 

Albert Smith

Chief Operating Officer

Al Smith serves as Chief Operating Officer for Hotel Equities, leading enterprise-wide performance across HE’s growing portfolio of hotels, resorts and outdoor hospitality destinations throughout the US, Canada, the Caribbean and Latin America.

Al most recently served as Senior Vice President, Lifestyle Hotels, with Highgate Hotels. Prior to that role, he served as Senior Vice President at Pivot Hotels & Resorts for Davidson Hospitality where he created and successfully grew their lifestyle division to a hotel portfolio of twenty-five during his five-year tenure. A 20-year luxury hospitality veteran, Al has held key leadership roles in ground-breaking hospitality companies including Viceroy Hotel Group, SBE, and Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants.

Hotel Equities Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Executive Appointments Across New Divisions 

### Hotel Equities Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Executive Appointments Across New Divisions 

 November 10, 2025 

Atlanta, GA – Hotel Equities (HE), a leading hospitality operator and developer, announces a series of strategic executive appointments across its Full Service, Focused Service, and Lifestyle divisions. These moves and additions will drive innovation, enhance performance, and help create lasting guest experiences across the portfolio—priorities for HE in generating long-term value for key owners and stakeholders.

“These executives bring exceptional talent and diverse industry experience to their newly created roles,” said Albert Smith, Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities. “Their leadership is integral as we continue to strengthen our lifestyle, full-, and select-service divisions across the U.S., Canada, and CALA, enhancing value for our owners and partners. By promoting from within, we’re investing in high performers who will help us grow our portfolio and expand our platform for innovation — from traditional hotels to new concepts like our leading outdoor hospitality brand, Postcard Cabins.”

Newly announced positions include:

Peter Tziahanas, President, Full Service Division

Peter Tziahanas joined Hotel Equities in 2021 and previously served as Executive Vice President of Operations, overseeing key lifestyle and owned assets across the firm’s portfolio. In his new role, he collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence, profitability, and enhanced guest and employee engagement. Before joining HE, Peter held several multi-unit leadership positions with prominent management groups, including Pivot Hotels at Davidson Hospitality Group, where he successfully led the lifestyle operating vertical.

David Rosenberg, President, Focused Service Division

David Rosenberg joined Hotel Equities in 2020 and most recently served as Executive Vice President of Operations, where he oversaw the deployment of analytics-driven performance dashboards, managed M&A integrations, and led a substantial portion of HE’s multi-branded hotel portfolio. He also guided the company’s entry into the outdoor hospitality segment through the integration of Postcard Cabins into the portfolio. Hotel Equities Announces Key Leadership Appointments After Strategic Merger With Springboard Hospitality

### Hotel Equities Announces Key Leadership Appointments After Strategic Merger With Springboard Hospitality

July 02, 2025

ATLANTA & HONOLULU – July 2, 2025 — As part of the strategic integration following the merger of Springboard Hospitality and Hotel Equities, the combined hospitality management company announces two key leadership appointments: Albert Smith as Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities and Rob Robinson as President of Springboard Hospitality. These executive placements mark a significant milestone in aligning leadership for the organization’s integration post-merger.

“These leadership appointments reflect our commitment to operational excellence and strategic expansion as we continue to unify our platform,” said Ben Rafter, Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities. “Rob’s leadership has been instrumental to Springboard’s evolution, and Al brings a proven track record in scaling high-performing hotel portfolios. Together, they will help shape the future of our organization and deliver value to our stakeholders.”

About Albert Smith

Based in Atlanta, Smith now leads enterprise-wide operations for Hotel Equities, with responsibility for optimizing performance across hotels, resorts, and outdoor hospitality destinations throughout the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America.

Smith most recently served as President of Hotel Operations at Hotel Equities, where he oversaw the strategic management and growth of the company's hotel portfolio. Prior to joining HE, he was Senior Vice President of Lifestyle Hotels at Highgate, leading a portfolio of independent, full-service luxury hotels across the East Coast. Earlier in his career, Smith held senior roles at Pivot Hotels & Resorts for Davidson Hospitality, Viceroy Hotel Group, SBE Entertainment, and Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, building a reputation for operational excellence, brand development, and strategic leadership.

With over 20 years of experience in upper-upscale and luxury hospitality, Smith brings a holistic understanding of hotel operations across a range of disciplines, including sales, marketing, revenue management, brand development and talent strategy. His appointment reinforces HE’s commitment to operational strength and scalable growth across all verticals.

### Hotel Equities ' Top Executives 

 Ben Rafter is the chief executive officer of Hotel Equities, a leading hospitality management and development firm with a diverse portfolio of hotels, resorts and outdoor hospitality destinations spanning the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America. Formerly president and CEO of Springboard Hospitality, Rafter assumed leadership of the newly merged Hotel Equities and Springboard Hospitality on May 1, 2025. After joining Springboard Hospitality in 2016, Rafter led the company’s transformation from a 16-property firm (formerly known as OLS Hotels & Resorts) into a respected third-party management powerhouse with nearly 50 properties across 14 states. His leadership focused on revitalizing the brand through investments in technology, people, and culture—an approach he continues to champion at Hotel Equities. Rafter steered Springboard through substantial growth coming out of the COVID-19 pandemic, expanding its presence on the East Coast and in key leisure markets including Stowe, VT; Branson, MO; Myrtle Beach, SC; Kona, HI; and Rancho Santa Fe, CA. He also launched the innovative Hospitality Intelligence (H.I.) platform, blending cutting-edge technology and human insight to enhance operational efficiency and guest experiences.
